mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 0.25% increase in FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real GDP signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances following a 2% YoY increase in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate indicates economic weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a 0.5% increase in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 1% MoM decrease in INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts signals increased consumer demand and economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the correlation between HOUST and S&P 500 60-day forward returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate combined with a rise in consumer price index signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative real returns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS and an increase in CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances following an increase in PAYEMS and a decrease in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances following a 1% MoM increase in RSAFS.
